review_sample.selection_method: stable SHA256 ranking, round-robin suite/outcome strata, prefer task diversity; deterministic purposive review, not a prevalence sample

repeat_consistency.note: Repeated seeds estimate stochastic variability within a task/style/goal cell; repeats do not increase independent task sample size. Legacy disagreement fields compare raw values, including null. Known comparisons require at least two completed Boolean observations; partial coverage retains unknown repeats. Clean attack-success outcomes are not applicable and are excluded.

startup_observations.scope: managed process launch until health-ready; OS disk caches uncontrolled

measurement_provenance.score_source: pinned AgentDojo programmatic task utility and injection state checkers; no LLM judge
measurement_provenance.latency_source: result.duration_seconds (monotonic wall-clock), includes errors, tools and client overhead
measurement_provenance.token_source: native response usage, summed across actual requests; repeated prompt context counts again
measurement_provenance.throughput_source: native decode sums max(predicted_n-1,0) / sum(predicted_ms/1000), matching the pinned llama.cpp first-token-in-prefill convention; prefill sums prompt_n / sum(prompt_ms/1000); response throughput separately uses usage.completion_tokens / client response latency
measurement_provenance.exposure_source: result.observed_injection_vectors; exact payload normalized/raw-or-YAML matcher before each sent request
measurement_provenance.memory_source: server_memory.peak_rss_bytes sampled every 0.1s; unified/GPU total and harness memory unmeasured
measurement_provenance.startup_source: captured runtime metadata ready_at minus started_at, deduplicated by pid/start timestamp; OS caches uncontrolled
measurement_provenance.intervals: 95% Wilson if one episode per unique task; otherwise deterministic task-cluster bootstrap stratified by suite, 2000 percentile resamples seed0; one cluster has no bootstrap interval; all-equal clusters can produce degenerate intervals
measurement_provenance.annotation_source: manual trace review only; refusal candidates are regex triage, never automatically scored

pooled_request_metrics.source: Native requests.csv rows passed through unchanged _request_measurements
pooled_request_metrics.scope: Only returned responses supply tokens/native timing; failed compute is unknown. Native masks pair numerator/time; rates are not means of episode rates. request_latency_seconds includes observed failed-request latency.

limitations: 60 fixed task clusters, two stochastic seeds; episodes are not 120 independent tasks.
Official programmatic scores are retained despite documented checker limitations.
Agent trace review is not independent human annotation or a validated LLM judge.
Unknown timeout scores/failed-request tokens remain unknown, never zero compute.
Fixed run order and shared host load/thermal drift confound performance comparisons.
RSS measures the server process, not total GPU/unified-device memory.
